record.question: The _____ servant always agreed with every command of the master.
record.explanation: Fawning describes servile or flattering conduct intended to gain favor. It best fits a servant who agrees with every command of a master. Independent and defiant oppose the behavior, while honest does not express submissive agreement. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026.
